title: finding(plugin-timeline,docs): the published README's "Schema-Driven Usage" node is spelled `component: 'timeline'` — validate refuses it as written; every other package README spells `type:`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` public door, measured — `safeValidateSchema` (what `objectui validate` runs) refuses the README's document exactly as written. Reader: the `domain:ui` seat #1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560), which dispatches it after triage grades it. Filed by that seat, `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`, from the objectui#6356 dev report `5858110390` (PR objectui#10822). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (objectui `origin/main`, read by this seat)

`packages/plugin-timeline/README.md:65` — the "Schema-Driven Usage" example spells its node `component: 'timeline',`. `README.md` is in the package's published `files` (`["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md","LICENSE"]`), so the text ships on npm.

## Measured

- By the objectui#6356 dev: `safeValidateSchema` refuses the README document as written (`invalid_union` at `type`) and accepts it respelled `type: 'timeline'`.
- By this seat, a census over `packages/*/README.md` on `origin/main`: nodes spelled `component: '…',` → **1** (this line); nodes spelled `type: '…',` → **25** (the lit control). ⇒ one site, not a family.

An AI or a human copying the README's example gets a document the validator refuses. The fix is one word.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Respell the node `type: 'timeline'`, and re-read the rest of that example against the current `TimelineSchema` (objectui#6356 is changing the item element; if PR objectui#10822 has landed, the example's items must fit the declared element).

## Dedupe

REST listing of the 500 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, grepped locally for `README … component: 'timeline'`, `plugin-timeline … README`, `Schema-Driven Usage`, and `component: '…' instead of type`: 1 hit, PR objectui#10822 (the reporting dev's PR, not a carrier). Lit control: `plugin-timeline` in the same corpus: 19 hits.

Dedupe words: `plugin-timeline README component timeline` · `Schema-Driven Usage component instead of type` · `README node spelled component`
